what: Rows published to the shared store by CI runs of POC-6 over 3,000 identifier-bearing rows (ai4privacy/pii-masking-200k). The first run published 16; after the credential patch the second published 4, all of them bank-account numbers. Text is as quoted in those reports, truncated there, so a row whose identifier fell past the cut cannot be judged here.
